name: MiAttachment
summary: File or image attachment card with media, title, description, upload state and actions; compose parts or use the name/fileSize shortcut props.

props.name: state
props.doc: Upload state; uploading and processing show a shimmer.

props.name: size
props.doc: Card size.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Stack media above content when vertical.

props.name: name
props.doc: Shortcut: file name (used when no default slot is given).

props.name: fileSize
props.doc: Shortcut: size in bytes.

props.name: type
props.doc: Shortcut: MIME type; image types get an image icon.

props.name: preview
props.doc: Shortcut: thumbnail URL for images.

props.name: progress
props.doc: Shortcut: upload progress 0-100, shows the uploading state below 100.

props.name: error
props.doc: Shortcut: error text; switches to the error state.

props.name: removable
props.doc: Shortcut: show the remove button.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Custom card content; replaces the built-in media, title, description and remove button built from the shortcut props.

name: MiAttachmentAction
summary: Icon button inside attachment actions; give it an aria-label.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Button content, usually an icon.

name: MiAttachmentActions
summary: Container for attachment action buttons, kept above the full-card trigger.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: MiAttachmentAction buttons shown at the card edge.

name: MiAttachmentContent
summary: Text column of an attachment holding the title and description.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: MiAttachmentTitle and MiAttachmentDescription stacked in a column.

name: MiAttachmentDescription
summary: Secondary attachment text such as type, size or upload status.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Secondary text such as file size, type or upload status.

name: MiAttachmentGroup
summary: Scrollable snapping row of attachments.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: MiAttachment cards laid out in a scrollable row.

name: MiAttachmentMedia
summary: Media slot of an attachment: an icon tile, or a full image when variant is image.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `image` fills the tile with the slotted img.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Icon or img shown in the tile.

name: MiAttachmentTitle
summary: Attachment file name, truncated to one line.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: File name text, truncated with an ellipsis.

name: MiAttachmentTrigger
summary: Full-card overlay that opens a link or fires click, while actions stay independently clickable.

props.name: href
props.doc: Renders an anchor when set, otherwise a button.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Accessible content of the overlay, such as a visually hidden label.

name: MiCodeBlock
summary: Code, terminal output and diff display with optional header, line numbers and copy button; compose MiCodeBlock* parts or pass `code`.

props.name: code
props.doc: Shortcut: source text, rendered when no default slot is given.

props.name: filename
props.doc: Shortcut: header title.

props.name: language
props.doc: Shortcut: header title when there is no filename.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.doc: Shortcut: show line numbers.

props.name: copyable
props.doc: Shortcut: show the copy button.

props.name: size
props.doc: Compact size for tool output.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Destructive tints the block for errors.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Custom block layout; replaces the built-in header and content built from the shortcut props.

slots.name: highlighted
slots.doc: Pre-highlighted code markup (for example from a syntax highlighter) shown instead of the plain text.

name: MiCodeBlockActions
summary: Action buttons of a code block header.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Buttons such as MiCodeBlockCopyButton, pushed to the end of the header.

name: MiCodeBlockContent
summary: Scrollable code body; give it a string (split into lines) or MiCodeBlockLine children.

props.name: wrap
props.doc: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.doc: Show line numbers (copy-safe, via CSS counters).

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Code as plain text, split into lines, or MiCodeBlockLine elements for per-line emphasis.

name: MiCodeBlockCopyButton
summary: Copy-to-clipboard button for a code block header.

props.name: value
props.doc: Text to copy.

name: MiCodeBlockFooter
summary: Footer area of a code block.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Footer content such as a caption or run status.

name: MiCodeBlockHeader
summary: Header row of a code block holding the title and actions.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: MiCodeBlockTitle and MiCodeBlockActions.

name: MiCodeBlockLine
summary: One code line with an optional highlighted, added or removed variant.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Line emphasis.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Text of the line.

name: MiCodeBlockTitle
summary: Title in a code block header, such as a filename or Terminal.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Title text, such as a filename or language.

name: MiQuestionnaire
summary: Multi-step questionnaire form with single, multiple, freeform and skippable questions; compose MiQuestionnaire* parts or pass a `questions` shortcut. v-model holds answers by question name.

props.name: questions
props.doc: Shortcut questions, rendered when no default slot is given.

props.name: defaultItem
props.doc: Name of the question to show first; defaults to the first.

props.name: shortcuts
props.doc: `letters` lets A, B, C... pick the matching choice.

props.name: modelValue
props.doc: Answers keyed by question id; each value is the choice id(s) or free text entered.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Custom questionnaire layout built from MiQuestionnaire* parts; replaces the layout generated from `questions`.

types: interface MiQuestion { name: string; title: string; description?: string; choices?: { value: string, label: string, description?: string }[]; /** Allow several choices. */ multiple?: boolean; required?: boolean; /** Adds a free-text input; its label is the aria-label. */ input?: { label: string, placeholder?: string } }
type MiAnswer = string | string[]

name: MiQuestionnaireActions
summary: Row holding the questionnaire navigation buttons.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Navigation buttons: previous, skip, next and submit.

name: MiQuestionnaireChoice
summary: Radio (single) or checkbox (multiple) choice inside a questionnaire item.

props.name: value
props.doc: Value stored in the answer.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Choice label; falls back to the raw value when empty.

name: MiQuestionnaireChoices
summary: Container for the choices and optional free-text input of a question.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: MiQuestionnaireChoice options and an optional MiQuestionnaireInput.

name: MiQuestionnaireDescription
summary: Helper text under a question title.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Helper text explaining the question.

name: MiQuestionnaireError
summary: Validation message of its item, announced as an alert.

name: MiQuestionnaireInput
summary: Free-text answer alongside the choices; pass aria-label and placeholder.

name: MiQuestionnaireItem
summary: One question step; only the active item is visible. Items register in render order.

props.name: name
props.doc: Answer key and form field name.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Allow several choices.

props.name: required
props.doc: Block Next until answered; hides Skip.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Title, description, choices and error of one question.

name: MiQuestionnaireNext
summary: Submit-on-Enter button that advances to the next question; hidden on the last one.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Button label; defaults to "Next".

name: MiQuestionnairePrevious
summary: Button that goes back one question; disabled on the first.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Button label; defaults to "Previous".

name: MiQuestionnaireProgress
summary: Progress bar and "n of N" label for the questionnaire.

name: MiQuestionnaireSkip
summary: Button that skips the current question; hidden for required questions.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Button label; defaults to "Skip".

name: MiQuestionnaireSubmit
summary: Final button that validates and emits the questionnaire submit event; shown on the last question.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Button label; defaults to "Submit".

name: MiQuestionnaireTitle
summary: Question title, rendered as the legend of its item.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Question text.

name: MiTrace
summary: Trace container for reasoning, tool calls and sources; compose MiTraceLine rows or pass a `steps` shortcut.

props.name: steps
props.doc: Shortcut steps, rendered when no default slot is given.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the list.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Custom trace content built from MiTraceLine and MiTraceCollapsible rows; replaces the rows generated from `steps`.

types: interface MiTraceStep { id?: string; title: string; /** Secondary text such as a count or tool name. */ description?: string; status?: 'done' | 'running' | 'error' | 'pending'; /** Duration in milliseconds. */ duration?: number; /** Collapsible detail text. */ detail?: string; /** Start expanded. */ open?: boolean }

name: MiTraceCollapsible
summary: Expandable trace row; v-model:open for controlled state or defaultOpen for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the row is expanded. Leave unset to let `defaultOpen` and the trigger manage it.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: A MiTraceCollapsibleTrigger followed by a MiTraceCollapsibleContent.

name: MiTraceCollapsibleContent
summary: Expandable detail of a trace row; unmounted while closed unless keepMounted.

props.name: keepMounted
props.doc: Keep children mounted (hidden) while closed, preserving nested open state.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Detail shown while the row is expanded.

name: MiTraceCollapsibleTrigger
summary: Button that toggles its MiTraceCollapsible parent.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Row content, usually a MiTraceLine, that toggles the detail when pressed.

name: MiTraceDescription
summary: Secondary trace text after the title, such as a count or duration.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Secondary text such as a count, tool name or duration.

name: MiTraceIcon
summary: Decorative leading icon of a trace line, hidden from assistive tech.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Status icon, for example a spinner, check or dash.

name: MiTraceLine
summary: Single trace row; status styles it as running, error or pending.

props.name: status
props.doc: Row status; omit for a finished row.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: MiTraceIcon, MiTraceTitle and MiTraceDescription for the row.

name: MiTraceTitle
summary: Main text of a trace line.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Main label of the step.

name: MiAspectRatio
summary: Container that keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio.

props.name: ratio
props.doc: Width divided by height, e.g. `16 / 9`.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Content sized to fill the ratio box, such as an image or video.

name: MiBlockquote
summary: Quotation as a semantic figure with blockquote and figcaption, with an optional author, role, avatar and source link; plain, bordered or card look.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Look: `plain` has just the text, `bordered` adds a brand rule on the leading edge, `card` puts it on an elevated surface with a large quote mark.

props.name: quote
props.doc: Quoted text, as a shortcut for the default slot.

props.name: cite
props.doc: Author of the quote, shown in the caption.

props.name: role
props.doc: Secondary caption line, e.g. job title or publication.

props.name: source
props.doc: URL of the source, set as the `cite` attribute of the blockquote.

props.name: size
props.doc: Text size.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: The quoted text (when `quote` is not used).

slots.name: cite
slots.doc: Replaces the author block in the caption.

slots.name: avatar
slots.doc: Avatar or logo shown beside the author.

name: MiColorPicker
summary: Hex color field plus preset swatches that edit the primary or secondary brand color and apply it to the theme live.

props.name: target
props.doc: Which brand color this picker edits.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible title of the field; defaults to Primary or Secondary from the target.

props.name: presets
props.doc: Preset swatches (hex). Defaults to the kit presets for the target.

name: MiColorRamp
summary: Nine-step tonal ramp (50-800) generated from one base color; use it to preview or document a brand color scale.

props.name: color
props.doc: Base color (becomes step 500). Falls back to the default primary when invalid.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Show the step labels (50-800) inside the cells.

props.name: height
props.doc: Row height in px.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the ramp.

name: MiDevice
summary: Pure CSS device frame (phone, tablet, laptop or browser window) that scales with its container and shows the default slot as the screen.

props.name: device
props.doc: Which device to draw.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Portrait or landscape; applies to `phone` and `tablet` only.

props.name: url
props.doc: Address shown in the toolbar of the `browser` device; its protocol is hidden.

props.name: tone
props.doc: Bezel color: `auto` is dark and lifts slightly in dark mode, or force `dark` or `light`.

props.name: maxWidth
props.doc: Largest width in px; the device shrinks with its container. Defaults depend on the device.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name; when set the frame is exposed as a labelled group.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Content of the screen; it fills the screen and is clipped to its rounded corners.

name: MiDirection
summary: Provider that sets the reading direction (LTR or RTL) for its subtree and exposes it to descendants.

props.name: direction
props.doc: Reading direction applied to the subtree.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Content that inherits the reading direction.

name: MiIcon
summary: Inline SVG icon from the built-in set or raw SVG markup; decorative (aria-hidden) unless label is set; spin for loaders.

props.name: name
props.doc: Name from the built-in set.

props.name: svg
props.doc: Raw inner SVG markup (24x24 grid). Trusted, static markup only. Takes precedence over `name`.

props.name: size
props.doc: Width and height: a number in px or a CSS length string (e.g. '1.25em').

props.name: weight
props.doc: Stroke width on the 24x24 grid.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name. When omitted the icon is decorative and hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: filled
props.doc: Fill the shape with the current color while keeping the outline (SF "fill" variants).

props.name: spin
props.doc: Rotate continuously (activity indicators). Transform-only animation.

name: MiKbd
summary: Keyboard key or short keyboard input, rendered as a small keycap; with `shortcut` it also listens for that key and presses down when it is hit.

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Shortcut to listen for, such as `Esc`, `K` or `Ctrl K`. Leave unset for a purely visual keycap.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Key name or symbol, such as Ctrl or Esc.

name: MiKbdGroup
summary: Groups several MiKbd keys in a row, e.g. a shortcut like Ctrl + K; with `shortcut` the whole group listens for the combination and presses down when it is hit.

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Combination to listen for, such as `Ctrl K` or `⇧⌘P`. Leave unset for a purely visual group.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: MiKbd keys that form one shortcut.

name: MiLabel
summary: Accessible form label bound to a control by id, with optional required marker and disabled styling.

props.name: for
props.doc: Id of the control this label describes.

props.name: required
props.doc: Show a required asterisk (hidden from assistive tech).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Dim the label to match a disabled control.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Label text, shown before the required marker.

name: MiLogo
summary: Mica logo: lowercase "mica" wordmark, short "m." form or dot only; the full stop follows the brand color (--mi-p), optional breathing dot for loading states.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `wordmark` = "mica.", `short` = "m." for tight spaces and app icons, `dot` = the full stop alone.

props.name: size
props.doc: Rendered height: a number in px or a CSS length string (e.g. '1em'). Width follows the aspect ratio.

props.name: tone
props.doc: Letter color: `label` (default text color), `inherit` (currentColor) or `on-primary` for use on a --mi-p fill.

props.name: dot
props.doc: Full stop color: `primary` (--mi-p), `secondary` (--mi-s) or `inherit` to match the letters (monochrome).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name.

props.name: decorative
props.doc: Hide from assistive tech when the name is already visible next to the logo.

props.name: pulse
props.doc: Breathing dot (transform/opacity only) for loading states; set aria-busy on the busy region yourself.

name: MiSeparator
summary: Thin line that visually or semantically separates content, horizontal or vertical.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Direction of the line.

props.name: decorative
props.doc: Purely visual: renders with role="none" and no separator semantics.

name: MiSurface
summary: Container surface (card, elevated or translucent material) with radius, padding and shadow presets; use it to group content.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Look of the surface: flat `card`, shadowed `elevated` or translucent blurred `material`.

props.name: material
props.doc: Translucency of the `material` variant.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner rounding from `xs` to `xl`, or fully rounded `capsule`.

props.name: padding
props.doc: Inner spacing: none, sm (12px), md (18px) or lg (24px).

props.name: elevation
props.doc: Shadow depth 0-3 (`--mi-sh1..3`). Defaults to 1 for cards, 2 for elevated, 0 for materials.

props.name: as
props.doc: Tag or component to render instead of the default div (e.g. 'section', 'li').

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Content grouped on the surface.

name: MiText
summary: Text with the system-style type scale (largeTitle to caption2), semantic tag, tone and optional line clamp; use it for all copy.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Type scale step that sets size, line height, default weight and default element.

props.name: as
props.doc: Element to render. Defaults to a heading for titles and `p` otherwise.

props.name: tone
props.doc: `primary`/`secondary` are the BRAND colors; for muted body text use `label2` (or `label3` for hints).

props.name: weight
props.doc: Overrides the variant's default font weight.

props.name: align
props.doc: Horizontal text alignment, flipping with the reading direction.

props.name: lines
props.doc: Clamp to this many lines with an ellipsis (1 = single-line truncation).

props.name: tabular
props.doc: Tabular (fixed-width) numerals, for aligned figures and counters.

props.name: balance
props.doc: Balance line lengths when wrapping (text-wrap: balance), for short headings.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Text content.

name: MiThemeSwitcher
summary: Segmented control to switch the app appearance (light, dark or system) via useMiTheme; icon-only variant for tight toolbars.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the group.

props.name: iconOnly
props.doc: Hide the text labels and keep icons only (labels stay available to assistive tech).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Override the visible option texts per mode (e.g. translated labels).

name: MiTypography
summary: Prose styles for headings, paragraphs, blockquotes, lists, inline code, lead and muted text.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Style to apply; also picks the default element.

props.name: as
props.doc: Element to render instead of the default.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Content styled with the chosen prose variant.

name: MiButton
summary: Button for actions and CTAs: 6 variants (filled, tinted, gray, plain, bordered, destructive), renders an anchor when href is set.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual style of the button, from the most to the least emphasized.

props.name: brand
props.doc: Color family used by the button: primary, secondary or a semantic one.

props.name: size
props.doc: Height and padding of the button.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows a busy state, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks like disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Blocks interaction and dims the button.

props.name: block
props.doc: Stretches to the full width of the container.

props.name: soft
props.doc: Destructive variant only: gray background with red text.

props.name: href
props.doc: Renders an anchor instead of a button.

props.name: type
props.doc: Native button type; use submit inside forms. Ignored when href is set.

props.name: pressed
props.doc: Sets `aria-pressed` for toggle buttons.

props.name: state
props.doc: Forces a visual state (docs and visual tests).

slots.name: leading
slots.doc: Icon shown before the label; replaced by the spinner while loading.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Label of the button.

slots.name: trailing
slots.doc: Icon shown after the label.

name: MiButtonGroup
summary: Groups related buttons: attached strip, segmented selector bound to v-model, or split button with a primary action and menu.

props.name: variant
props.doc: attached: put MiButton or MiIconButton children in the default slot, they render as one bordered strip. segmented: pass `options` and v-model. split: a MiButton for the main action, then a MiMenu whose `#trigger="{ props }"` renders `<MiButton v-bind="props">` with a chevron.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the group.

props.name: options
props.doc: Segmented only: renders the options as toggle buttons bound to v-model.

props.name: modelValue
props.doc: Value of the selected option in `segmented` mode.

slots.name: option
slots.doc: Custom content of each segmented option; defaults to its label.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: The buttons or menu to group, for the attached and split variants.

types: interface MiSegmentOption { value: string | number; /** Visible text. Omit for icon-only options and provide `ariaLabel`. */ label?: string; ariaLabel?: string; disabled?: boolean }

name: MiCopyButton
summary: Button that copies a string to the clipboard, swaps its icon and label to a confirmation, and announces it to screen readers.

props.name: value
props.doc: Text to copy. Ignored when `getValue` is set.

props.name: getValue
props.doc: Function returning the text at click time (sync or async); wins over `value`.

props.name: label
props.doc: Button text and accessible name before copying. Empty hides the text (icon only, the name stays).

props.name: copiedLabel
props.doc: Text and accessible name shown right after copying; announced politely.

props.name: timeout
props.doc: How long the confirmation stays, in ms.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual style: subtle tinted, outlined, or icon-only quiet.

props.name: iconOnly
props.doc: Hides the visible text and shows only the icon.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Blocks interaction and dims the button.

slots.name: icon
slots.doc: Replaces the idle icon.

name: MiIconButton
summary: Icon-only button, always labelled, for toolbars and compact actions: 4 variants, 4 sizes, optional pressed toggle.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name. Icon buttons are always labelled.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual style of the button, from the most to the least emphasized.

props.name: brand
props.doc: Color family used by the button: primary, secondary or a semantic one.

props.name: size
props.doc: Diameter or height of the button, including the toolbar size.

props.name: shape
props.doc: Defaults to circle, or rounded for the toolbar size.

props.name: pressed
props.doc: Sets `aria-pressed` and the pressed look (toolbar toggles).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Blocks interaction and dims the button.

props.name: type
props.doc: Native button type; use submit inside forms.

props.name: state
props.doc: Forces a visual state: rest, hover or focus (docs and visual tests).

slots.name: default
slots.doc: The icon to display.

name: MiMenu
summary: Dropdown trigger with a floating panel: popup picks a value (listbox), pulldown runs actions; keyboard and typeahead support.

props.name: items
props.type: { value?: string | number; label?: string; shortcut?: string; disabled?: boolean; destructive?: boolean; checked?: boolean; separator?: boolean; heading?: string }[]
props.doc: Entries of the menu as MiMenuItem objects.

props.name: variant
props.doc: popup: shows the selected value (listbox); pulldown: shows an action menu.

props.name: label
props.doc: Trigger text (placeholder for popup when nothing is selected).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the trigger and the menu.

props.name: placement
props.doc: Side and alignment of the panel relative to the trigger.

props.name: offset
props.doc: Gap in px between the trigger and the panel.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Blocks opening and dims the trigger.

props.name: globalShortcuts
props.doc: Also run item shortcuts while the menu is closed. By default they run only while it is open.

props.name: modelValue
props.doc: Value of the chosen item in `popup` mode.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the menu panel is open.

slots.name: trigger
slots.doc: Custom trigger element; spread the given props on it so it opens the menu.

slots.name: icon
slots.doc: Icon shown before the text of each item.

slots.name: item
slots.doc: Custom content of each item; defaults to its label.

types: interface MiMenuItem { /** Unique value. Required for actionable items. */ value?: string | number; label?: string; /** Keyboard shortcut such as `⌘D`, `⇧⌘M` or `Cmd N`: shown as a hint and pressing it selects the item while the menu is open (always with `globalShortcuts`). Bare Enter, Space, Tab, Esc and arrows are ignored. */ shortcut?: string; disabled?: boolean; destructive?: boolean; /** Renders the item as a checkbox-like item. */ checked?: boolean; /** Renders a divider. */ separator?: boolean; /** Renders a non-interactive group heading. */ heading?: string }

name: MiTextLink
summary: Inline text link in brand colour with optional trailing chevron, for navigation in running text or CTAs.

props.name: href
props.doc: Destination of the link.

props.name: brand
props.doc: Color family of the link text.

props.name: chevron
props.doc: Shows the trailing chevron.

slots.name: default
slots.doc: Text of the link.

name: MiBarChart
summary: Column chart for comparing values across categories. Data is { label, value, color? }[]; valueLabels is peak, all or none.

props.name: data
props.type: { label: string; value: number; color?: string }[]
props.doc: Columns as { label, value, color? }[], in display order.

props.name: title
props.doc: Heading shown above the chart inside the card.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: Secondary line under the title, for context such as period or unit.

props.name: card
props.doc: Wraps the chart in the elevated card surface; turn off to embed it in your own container.

props.name: unit
props.doc: Suffix added to tick labels and values, e.g. "%".

props.name: max
props.doc: Fixed top of the value axis; defaults to a nice scale over the data.

props.name: ticks
props.doc: Number of axis intervals.

props.name: height
props.doc: Total chart height in px, including the axis labels.

props.name: maxBarWidth
props.doc: Widest a column may be, in px.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius in px of the top of each column.

props.name: valueLabels
props.doc: peak: label the tallest column (or the hovered one). all: label every column. none: tooltip only.

props.name: animate
props.doc: Grows the columns in on mount.

props.name: formatValue

props.name: invalid

props.name: modelValue

props.doc: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

name: MiLocalNav
summary: Sticky in-page section tabs with v-model selection, arrow-key navigation and an optional call-to-action pill.

props.name: actionLabel

name: MiMenubar
summary: Horizontal application menu bar (File, Edit, View...) whose entries open MiMenu dropdowns; once one is open, hovering another trigger switches to it; Left/Right/Home/End move between menus.

props.name: menus
props.type: { id: string; label: string; items: MiMenuItem[]; disabled?: boolean }[]

name: MiNavBar
summary: iOS-style sticky header with a back link, a trailing action and an optional large title that collapses into the bar on scroll.

props.name: title

props.name: backLabel

props.name: actionLabel
props.doc: Trailing button label (emits action). Ignored when the trailing slot is used.

props.name: large
props.doc: Show the large title that collapses into the bar while scrolling.

props.doc: Scroll container: element or CSS selector. Defaults to the nearest scrollable ancestor, then the window.

props.name: collapsed

slots.name: trailing
slots.doc: Replaces the trailing action button.

slots.name: title
slots.doc: Replaces the large title content.

name: MiNavigationMenu
summary: Top navigation bar whose entries are plain links or triggers for flyout panels of titled links, opened on hover or click and shown in a shared viewport; v-model is the open item id.

props.name: items

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the navigation.

props.name: closeDelay

name: MiPageControl
summary: Dot pager for carousels and onboarding: one tab per item, v-model is the zero-based active index.

props.name: count

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the dot tablist.

props.name: itemLabel
props.doc: Label prefix of each dot, e.g. "Slide" gives "Slide 2".

props.name: modelValue
props.doc: Zero-based index of the active page.

name: MiPagination
summary: Page navigator with arrows, windowed page numbers and ellipses; v-model is the 1-based current page.

props.name: total
props.doc: Total number of pages.

props.name: siblings
props.doc: Page numbers shown on each side of the current page before the rest collapse into ellipses.

props.name: summary
props.doc: Show the "Page x of y" caption.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the pagination landmark.

props.name: modelValue
props.doc: Current page, 1-based.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the navigation.
